note: Layer URLs for atlanta-feed.mjs. Run `node tools/atlanta-intel/atlanta-feed.mjs --discover` to list candidates, then paste the /FeatureServer/<n> or /MapServer/<n> URL here (or set ATL_<KEY>_URL). Field names are matched by alias, so a layer rename doesn't need code changes; the run prints any field it couldn't map. County parcel layers: set counties.<name>.url (or COUNTY_<NAME>_URL) and the layer's ZIP field. Deeds come from a clerk's index CSV (--deeds), not a layer.

parcels.label: City of Atlanta lots + parcels (zoning, owner, mailing)

cama.label: Tolemi parcels (Fulton CAMA: year built, sq ft, beds, baths, homestead)

flood.label: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (flood hazard zones)

parcels_daily.label: COA tax parcels, daily owner update (reference)
parcels_daily.note: Current owner + mailing street, no ZIP; not yet merged

fulton_parcels.label: Fulton County tax parcels (official, reference)
fulton_parcels.note: No values; candidate for county-wide sweeps outside the city

dekalb.note: Tax_Parcels_2025 (services2.arcgis.com/IxVN2oUE9EYLSnPE) has values + zoning but no address/owner: needs a join layer before it can produce leads

gaps: Fulton appraised values and sale prices: not in any open layer found (qPublic / records request)
ATL311 citywide: no public layer found (only the Main Street district)
Gwinnett/Cobb/Clayton: public layers lack owner or value fields
